worker_judgment_notes: Selected the official Open Data BR Socrata incident feed because it is a runnable public API with event date, NIBRS offense code and description, Socrata row identity, and latitude/longitude point fields. This contract is share-lane only: rows are BRPD charge/offense records, not FBI annual counting units, and raw feed counts should not be promoted as annual totals. Socrata :id is used as the stable row identity because charge_id is not unique for repeated charge rows. The date field is charge_date; geography fields are latitude and longitude; offense mapping uses NIBRS codes rather than statute_category because local categories mix Part I and non-Part I offenses. Rape mapping follows the repo's SRS-equivalent 11A/11B/11C convention, but the point-coordinate subset appears highly incomplete for sexual assault because many such rows suppress coordinates; rape shares should therefore be treated as partial if admitted at all. Bounds come from the local 2020 TIGER block groups joined through state/geometry/block_group_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet for jurisdiction 22:municipal:place:2205000, and the runner will spatially join points to municipal block groups.
